name: GTBench
latest_version: The HF dataset id anvu99/GTBench does not exist/is inaccessible. The canonical project is the GitHub repo jinhaoduan/GTBench (paper arXiv:2402.12348), which has an HF Space leaderboard (GTBench/GTBench) but no static dataset of fixed rows on HF — it's a live LLM-vs-LLM game-generation framework over OpenSpiel (tic-tac-toe, connect-4, breakthrough, nim, Kuhn poker, etc). No newer versioned dataset release found.
note: GTBench generates game transcripts on the fly by running LLMs against each other via OpenSpiel; the repo contains only Python game/agent code, no static data files to sample a real row from. Treated as environment-only per instructions: raw_sample and openjev null.
review: The sample is a config file, not a decision. You must run the games to get data.

name: BALROG
latest_version: Actively maintained GitHub benchmark suite (NetHack, MiniHack, BabyAI, Crafter, TextWorld, Baba Is You). It is an evaluation harness over live environments, not a fixed dataset with stored rows; no separate HF dataset id found under this name.
size: code/environment suite, not a fixed-row dataset
note: BALROG runs agents live against Gym-style environments and produces trajectories only when you execute it; there is no static released dataset file to curl a row from. Per instructions (environment-only case): raw_sample and openjev null.

name: NetHack NLD
latest_version: The full NetHack Learning Dataset (NLD-AA / NLD-NAO, ~10B+3B state-action-score transitions) is distributed via the nle_data_loader / dataverse, not row-queryable on HF. Howuhh/nld-aa-taster is a small public HF 'taster' sample of NLD-AA (AutoAscend bot trajectories) and is the most recent easily-verifiable HF artifact; last modified 2023-05-03, no newer HF version found as of 2026-09-17.
size: 3B transitions / 100,000 trajectories (full); taster is a small subset (hdf5)
